title: A Bogoliubov-ratio framework for quantum-information diagnostics of time-dependent two-mode Boson System
summary: We formulate a compact dynamical representation of quantum-information diagnostics for time-dependent two-mode bosonic systems in terms of the Bogoliubov ratio $λ_k(η)=β_k(η)/α_k(η)$. For vacuum-evolved pure Gaussian pair states generated by a Hermitian quadratic Hamiltonian, $λ_k$ obeys a closed complex Riccati equation. After one partner mode is traced out, the reduced-state spectrum is determined by $q_k=|λ_k|^2$, from which the purity, linear entropy, Rényi-2 entropy, and von Neumann entropy follow directly.
